app_fee.value: The Registry sets a €70 application fee for most courses; the Graduate Admissions page says €60, so confirm the amount in the portal.
app_fee.quote: For most courses you must pay a €70 application fee.

also.quote: An application fee is required for most application types (€60).

fee_waiver.value: The pages checked list no international fee waiver; the only exemption named is for asylum seekers and refugees.
fee_waiver.quote: Asylum Seekers, Refugees, Internally Displaced Persons and those with subsidiary protection or Leave to remain are not required to pay the application fee.

gre_general.value: No GRE requirement appears on the graduate school or Registry pages checked.

toefl_min.value: UCD's minimum is a TOEFL iBT score of 90, with at least 21 in writing and 19 in every other section.
toefl_min.quote: iBT: 90 (no less than 21 in writing and at least 19 in every other section)

ielts_min.value: UCD's minimum is IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, with at least 6.0 in each band; retake scores are not accepted.
ielts_min.quote: An average score of 6.5 over all components and a minimum of 6.0 in each band

english_waiver.value: A degree taught in English can count as proof of English, but only at the discretion of the relevant board, so an Indian English-medium degree is not automatically accepted.
english_waiver.quote: For example, a degree taken through English or in an English-speaking country may be taken as proof of proficiency

notes: Registry (€70) and the Graduate Admissions How to Apply page (€60) disagree on the application fee. The English page says results must be under two years old; for September 2027 entry they must be from 1 February 2025 onward. No GRE policy or international fee waiver was found on the official pages checked.
